event_source.estimator_boundary: events plus fixed pinhole calibration only; no GT pose, target mask, depth, or future state
event_source.estimator_status: causal centroid/regression plumbing smoke; not a trained or validated perception model

voxel_convergence.status: paired 1/2 kHz voxels made from the same 0.5 ms physical/HDR trajectory

post_contact_controller_state_boundary: scores the actual causal event-derived observation propagated by the fixed predictor and used by the lift gate; evaluator GT aligns position/velocity after the episode and never enters the controller

dynamic_visibility_evaluator_only.method: live robot segmentation divided by target-only segmentation at matching GT pose; evaluator-only
